sloka: भर्तुः प्रियहिते युक्ते भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्क्षिणि ।स्निग्धमेवंविधं वाक्यं त्वमेवार्हसि भाषितुम् ।। ६.११६.२३ ।।
transliteration: bhartuḥ priyahite yukte bharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇi ।snigdhamevaṁvidhaṁ vākyaṁ tvamevārhasi bhāṣitum ।। 6.116.23 ।।

translations.english: "O gentle one! Your meaningful words full of affection are more valuable than clusters of gems or Indra, the Lord of gods."
